stories.title: The Birth of Jesus and the Magi
stories.summary: Joseph learns in a dream that Mary's child is from the Holy Spirit. Magi follow a star to Bethlehem and bring gifts to the child.

stories.title: Flight to Egypt and Return to Nazareth
stories.summary: Warned in a dream, Joseph takes the family to Egypt while Herod kills Bethlehem's boys. After Herod dies they return and settle in Nazareth.

stories.title: The Baptism and Temptation of Jesus
stories.summary: John baptizes Jesus in the Jordan, and a voice from heaven speaks. Jesus fasts forty days in the wilderness and answers the devil's three temptations with scripture.

stories.title: Calling the First Disciples
stories.summary: Jesus begins preaching in Galilee and calls Simon, Andrew, James and John to follow him. Crowds come for healing.

stories.title: The Sermon on the Mount
stories.summary: Jesus teaches the Beatitudes, interprets the law, and speaks about prayer, giving, treasure, anxiety, judging and the two ways.

stories.title: Healings and Calming the Storm
stories.summary: Jesus heals a leper, a centurion's servant, Peter's mother-in-law and a paralytic, calms a storm, and sends demons into pigs. He calls Matthew and raises a girl and heals a woman who touched his cloak.

stories.title: Sending Out the Twelve
stories.summary: Jesus names the twelve apostles and sends them to the lost sheep of Israel with instructions about provision and persecution.

stories.title: Jesus and John the Baptist
stories.summary: John, in prison, sends disciples to ask whether Jesus is the one to come. Jesus answers with his works and invites the weary to come to him.

stories.title: Sabbath Controversies and the Sign of Jonah
stories.summary: Jesus defends his disciples plucking grain on the Sabbath and heals a man's hand. When asked for a sign, he points to the sign of Jonah.

stories.title: Parables of the Kingdom
stories.summary: Jesus teaches in parables: the sower, the weeds, the mustard seed, the leaven, the hidden treasure, the pearl and the net.

stories.title: Feeding the Five Thousand and Walking on Water
stories.summary: John the Baptist is beheaded by Herod. Jesus feeds five thousand with five loaves and two fish and walks on the sea, and Peter briefly walks toward him.

stories.title: Peter's Confession and the Transfiguration
stories.summary: Peter says Jesus is the Christ, and Jesus foretells his death and resurrection. Six days later he is transfigured before Peter, James and John.

stories.title: Teaching on Forgiveness and Greatness
stories.summary: Jesus teaches about humility, the lost sheep, correcting a brother and forgiving seventy-seven times, and tells the parable of the unforgiving servant.

stories.title: The Rich Young Man
stories.summary: A rich young man cannot give up his possessions to follow Jesus. Jesus tells the parable of the workers in the vineyard and heals two blind men near Jericho.

stories.title: The Triumphal Entry and Temple Cleansing
stories.summary: Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a donkey, drives the merchants from the temple, curses a fig tree, and answers challenges to his authority.

stories.title: Teaching in the Temple and the Olivet Discourse
stories.summary: Jesus answers questions from opponents, denounces the scribes and Pharisees, and teaches about the end, including the parables of the ten virgins, the talents and the sheep and goats.

stories.title: The Last Supper and Gethsemane
stories.summary: A woman anoints Jesus, Judas agrees to betray him, and Jesus shares a Passover meal with the twelve. In Gethsemane he prays, and Judas arrives with an armed crowd.

stories.title: Trial, Crucifixion and Burial
stories.summary: Jesus is tried before Caiaphas and Pilate, Peter denies him, and Judas dies. Jesus is crucified, dies, and is buried in Joseph of Arimathea's tomb.

stories.title: The Resurrection and the Great Commission
stories.summary: Women find the tomb empty and meet the risen Jesus. The guards are paid to spread a false account, and Jesus sends the eleven to make disciples of all nations.
